note: One source of truth for what a dead FINVIZ_COOKIE costs while FINVIZ_API_TOKEN works (LQ-20261107-1289 item 4; extends LQ-20261107-1287 grok-b's audit). Every row is a call site that FETCHES with the cookie and has no working token substitute in the code as it stands. A call site with a working token fallback (export?s=..., grp_export.ashx, news_export.ashx, export?v=171) is deliberately absent: with the token alive it is not degraded. The banner and the operator alert both read this file; scripts/lib/finviz_cookie_features.py is the reader and tests/test_finviz_cookie_features_lq1289_20261108.py pins the evidence strings so this list cannot drift silently.

features.label: RSI/SMA/ATR for held positions
features.detail: Tier 2 scrapes elite.finviz.com/quote.ashx per ticker; the token export can serve view 171 but this path does not use it
features.impact: position technicals fall back to the stale snapshot; RSI/SMA/ATR alert triggers are suppressed

features.label: optionable-universe completeness
features.detail: screener.ashx HTML carries the declared total; the token export returns symbols only, so completeness cannot be proven
features.impact: discovery returns PARTIAL ('missing or changing source total') instead of COMPLETE

features.label: per-symbol news fallback
features.detail: the quote-page news scrape is the fallback when the token news export yields no headline mentioning the symbol
features.impact: symbols the token news export does not cover lose their headlines

features.label: technical chart image
features.detail: the on-demand /api/v2/finviz-chart proxy fetches elite.finviz.com/chart.ashx with the session cookie server-side (the browser cannot attach it); the token export serves no image at all
features.impact: the drawer and per-trade replay chart lose their image fallback; the route answers 502 'cookie expired'
